dedupe_keys.name: qols obstacle limitation surfaces plugin for qgis

description: qOLS is a QGIS plugin that creates the obstacle limitation surfaces of an aerodrome in accordance with ICAO Annex 14 volumes I and II, the imaginary surfaces around a runway that objects must not penetrate. It draws the current surfaces and is implementing the new surface concept; its roadmap lists surfaces set by runway classification from ICAO standard values, local configuration, obstacle evaluation, automatic reports and possibly FAA surfaces. It is published by FLYGHT7 on GitHub and installed from the official QGIS plugin repository. Coverage: one runway at a time, anywhere, in a projected coordinate system. Access: QGIS plugin and source code. Licence and cost: free; no licence file was found in the repository. Caveats: single-runway systems only, projected coordinates without geodetic calculations, and obstacle evaluation is not yet implemented. It supports airport planning, safeguarding of new buildings, masts or wind turbines near runways, and hazard exposure checks of airspace, and relates to airport location data such as OurAirports in the catalogue.
interoperability: QGIS layers in projected coordinate systems
licence: not stated in the repository (no licence file found); distributed through the QGIS plugin repository
